page.overview:
Who is Robert Stanton?

is the protagonist of The Cliffs, the first story in the book of the same name. He is a single father who's still mourning the loss of his wife and doesn't think he's enough for his son, Tyler. Robert buys a fancy teddy bear to watch over Tyler, but when Tyler disappears the bear begins pushing Robert to his limit.

Robert is not described in the story. In it's graphic novel adaptation, Robert is tall and skinny with spiky blond hair, blue eyes, an angular face, an aquiline nose, and stubble. In certain shots, his arms appear rather hairy.

Robert used to be happy and energetic. When Anna died, however, he became incredibly grief-stricken. Robert isolates himself from others in order to not feel their pity and care for Tyler. As a result he's painfully lonely, yet finds himself too busy and exhausted to change this. Robert also believes he's useless and inept as a father, relying on parenting books to get by. He becomes overwhelmed easily by memories of Anna, and Tyler’s similar appearance to her overwhelms Robert with love and fear. Robert is unwilling to discuss Anna, instead choking back his sadness to control his reactions. He also doesn’t care much for eating, only doing so when Tyler needs to. Robert isn’t really superstitious, yet is still scared and wary of supernatural stories told about the Cliffs. After Tyler’s disappearance, Robert becomes suicidal, while also being aggressive towards Tag-Along Freddy until all his feelings go numb. Robert later learns to love what he has and live his life better.

Robert is the father of his son, Tyler. His wife, Anna, died during childbirth. As a result, he dedicates most of his life to taking care of Tyler, knowing that he would never be enough for him. One day at the store, he purchases Tag-Along Freddy to keep watch over his son. He realizes that his life is easier knowing that something was keeping track of Tyler.
